append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1625). All four facts read from the owner's dashboard screenshots (Database, Backups) or timed in a rehearsal, with the restored copy checked by the orchestrator's read-only SQL; nothing inferred from the plan name. TIER: organisation on Pro; scheduled backups DAILY and PHYSICAL, taken about 11:45 to 11:51 UTC. RETENTION: 8 backups listed (22 to 29 Sep 2026), about 7 days. POINT-IN-TIME RECOVERY: not enabled ("available as an add-on"); owner ruling 2026-09-29 "Daily is enough", recorded as ADR-1625 with the revisit at 1,000 profiles or regular paid orders, whichever is first. RPO: up to 24 hours, shown: the copy from the 29 Sep 11:48:49 UTC backup held 745 migration ledger rows ending at 20270345009410, production 748 ending at 20270345009700, because 9500, 9600 and 9700 were applied at 16:28Z after the backup. RTO (database, click to ready): 12 minutes. Restore to new project clicked 18:14Z (11:14 PDT), ready 18:26Z; the copy ("Frequency Temp", wfgnxpvxddrzqyykrktn) verified 18:39Z: profiles 60 (= live), newest profile 2026-09-27 16:48 (= live), storage.objects 526 rows (= live, metadata only), 255 MB against live 261 MB. The owner deletes the scratch project (a paid-tier project cannot be paused; it bills at the same compute, $14.83 a month shown). WHOLE-SITE RTO is longer than 12 minutes and unmeasured: per Supabase's own dialog a restore does not carry storage files or storage settings, Edge Functions, auth settings and API keys, extensions and database settings, or read replicas, and per the Backups page database backups do not include objects stored via the Storage API. So a real move also needs the three Vercel Supabase variables re-pointed, auth settings re-entered, supabase/functions/embed redeployed, and the files, which have no backup anywhere: filed as OWN-084 (ownerAction ruling, it costs money).
